summary: User received a phone call impersonating Crypto.com claiming that someone was attempting to change account details. After responding to the call the user received a phishing email linking to a fake verification website designed to capture account information and legitimate verification codes.
prevention: End unsolicited security calls and contact the exchange through its official support channel / Never enter verification codes into websites reached through unsolicited emails or messages
classification_warning: multi-channel phishing using phone impersonation and fake email
